methodology: Stratified random sample: 2 apps per category (10 categories = 20 apps, seed=42), independently re-checked field-by-field against the SAME primary evidence URLs cited in pass1, but using a DIFFERENT tool/method than pass1 used -- WebFetch (direct page fetch + summarization) instead of Composio's Tavily-search-based run_tool.py. This is a genuine independent cross-check, not a re-run of the same method.

summary: Zero outright contradictions found across 20 independently-hand-checked apps (2 per category) using a second, different research method (direct WebFetch page-fetch instead of Composio's Tavily-search tool). 19/20 fully confirmed as-is; 1/20 was inconclusive due to a WebFetch rendering limitation on that specific site, not a factual error -- disclosed rather than silently dropped. Two records were sharpened with more precise evidence found during the cross-check (Datadog's dual-key nuance corrected; SE Ranking's pricing made more specific). This is consistent with -- and strengthens confidence in -- the broader pattern established earlier in the research process: the two direct WebFetch-based research failures in the ORIGINAL 10-app seed pass (Zendesk 403, NotebookLM wrong-guessed-URL) were both later recovered by switching to Composio's search-based tool, and no comparable failures were found in the full 100-app Composio-driven pass1 dataset during this independent re-check.
